components.name: Primary Confirm (Satz geschafft)
components.description: The thumb-zone confirm: ≥64px, hot orange, one per screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-live { background: #C2410C; color: #FFF4EE; min-height: 64px; padding: 0 32px; border: none; border-radius: 16px; font: 700 1rem Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.01em; box-shadow: 0 10px 26px -14px rgba(194,65,12,.75); transition: transform 90ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), background 90ms; } .ds-btn-live:hover { background: #D4551D; } .ds-btn-live:active { transform: translateY(1px); background: #8E2C07; } .ds-btn-live:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #291238; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary actions: raised fill, ink text.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: #EEE5F3; color: #291238; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border: none; border-radius: 16px; font: 600 0.875rem Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 90ms; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #E4D7EB; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #291238; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: State Chips
components.description: The state model as badges: filled carries dark on-fill text, outline carries the hue as text.
components.html: Rekord 4 ohne PR Erledigt Deload
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .35em; font: 700 0.8125rem Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 0.3em 0.7em; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid transparent; margin-right: 6px; } .ds-chip--record { background: #F0B429; color: #3A2600; } .ds-chip--stall { background: transparent; border-color: #0C7382; color: #0F6B78; } .ds-chip--done { background: #8B3A62; color: #FFF0F6; } .ds-chip--deload { background: transparent; border-color: #DACAE3; color: #634674; }

components.name: List Row
components.description: The one list grammar: name over quiet meta, optional trail. Rows divide with hairlines, never card grids.
components.html: Bankdrückenvor 5 Tagen · 62,5 kg3 × 8
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 0; border-top: 1px solid #DACAE3; text-decoration: none; } .ds-row__main { flex: 1; min-width: 0; } .ds-row__name { display: block; font: 600 1rem Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #291238; } .ds-row__meta { display: block; font: 400 0.8125rem Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #634674; margin-top: 1px; } .ds-row__trail { font: 700 0.875rem Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #291238; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Sheet Menu Row
components.description: Bottom-sheet action: raised icon tile, strong name, meta line answering the open question.
components.css: .ds-sheet-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 100%; min-height: 56px; padding: 8px 0; background: none; border: none; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-sheet-row__lead { flex: none; width: 38px; height: 38px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 16px; background: #EEE5F3; color: #634674; } .ds-sheet-row__main { flex: 1; min-width: 0; } .ds-sheet-row__name { display: block; font: 600 1rem Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #291238; } .ds-sheet-row__meta { display: block; font: 400 0.8125rem Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #634674; margin-top: 1px; } .ds-sheet-row:active { background: #EEE5F3; }

components.name: Number Cell
components.description: An editable value: inset raised cell, bold tabular numeral. Inset means editable, not elevated.
components.html: <input class="ds-num" type="number" value="62.5" aria-label="Gewicht in kg">

components.name: Field
components.description: Label above input, everywhere a form exists.
components.css: .ds-field__label { display: block; font: 600 0.75rem Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.11em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #634674; margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-field__input { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #C2ABCF; border-radius: 12px; font: 400 1rem Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #291238; } .ds-field__input::placeholder { color: #6C537E; } .ds-field__input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #291238; outline-offset: 1px; }

narrative.overview: Puls is an instrument you operate, not a dashboard you consult: standing up, one-handed, between sets. Every logged set advances something visible — a tick on the session strip, a chip going solid, the kilogram total counting up — and that accumulation stays on screen the whole time. Colour is committed, not accented: the page field is pale plum in light and deep aubergine in dark, with exactly three semantic hues (hot orange NOW, gold RECORD, cold cyan ATTENTION) plus pale rose for LOGGED.
keyCharacteristics: One committed page colour per theme; every pairing AA in both themes
Four states plus a label, inherited by every surface
One lifted plane per screen; hairline-divided rows elsewhere
Tabular numerals, largest thing in their container
90–220ms ease-out motion; accumulation is the choreography

rules.name: The One-Now Rule
rules.body: Only ever one thing on screen is NOW. Destructive actions are not orange.

rules.name: The Word-Plus-Colour Rule
rules.body: Every state carries a shape or a word as well as a colour.

rules.name: The Deload-Is-A-Label Rule
rules.body: Deload carries no hue: dim ink plus the literal word. Never promote it to a colour.

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Rule
rules.body: Exercise names are content: sentence case, body face, never caps, never italic.

rules.name: The Numerals-Lead Rule
rules.body: In any container that shows a number, the number is the biggest thing in it.

rules.name: The One-Lifted-Plane Rule
rules.body: If two panels float, one of them is wrong. Repeated identical cards are banned outright.

dos: Do validate every new colour pairing AA in both themes; light is usually the binding one
Do give every state a word or shape alongside its colour
Do put numerals in tabular figures at the top of their container's scale
Do compose new lists from .row and new menus from .sheet-row
Do keep the confirm target ≥64px in the thumb zone, everything else ≥44px
Do prefer silence: an unanswerable figure is absent, never a confident 0
donts: Don't use the amber-on-near-black instrument panel or the electric-blue sport broadcast — both built and rejected
Don't use lime/acid-green on near-black, violet-to-teal fitness gradients, or any near-black page background
Don't use italic anywhere, or uppercase exercise names
Don't spend colour decoratively — three semantic hues plus rose is the whole budget
Don't use emoji as icons; the inline-SVG set is Icon.tsx
Don't reach for Inter, Space Grotesk or Outfit — the face is Figtree, vendored
Don't nest cards, repeat identical cards, or float a second plane
Don't promote Deload to a colour
